review_notes:
The file has no definitions, structures or classes. It has four lemmas: specIdeal_injective, comap_fromSpec, ambientHyperplane_comap_equation and section_hyperplane_equation. The rubric covers competing concepts, not standalone theorem duplication, so none of these is a candidate.

The concept the file uses is specIdeal, which sends an ideal of R to an ideal sheaf on Spec R. It is defined elsewhere, not in this file. I grepped the repo for its definition and found copies in the NumberTheory/PiExponent/Ampleness/BlowupIdeal.lean and Seshadri/Sheaves/CartierModule.lean files. I did not locate the definition in the MaximalSeshadri.IdealPullback namespace that this file uses, and I did not check whether those copies are the same. Each copy I saw is defined as Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso ...).inv.hom). That is a transport of Mathlib's own constructor along ΓSpecIso, not a competing representation. Mathlib has Scheme.IdealSheafData.equivOfIsAffine and ofIdealTop at Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/IdealSheaf/Basic.lean, but nothing for Spec R that takes an ideal of R directly, so the wrapper is a named, chosen orientation. Any consolidation among the repo's own copies belongs to those other files, not this one. I found no justified finding for this file.
